boundedClaim: The 0900 TRY FOREVER source slice materially improves heartbeat accessibility and stable touch semantics, adds a broad non-raster constellation source specimen, preserves P0/phone ownership, and survives exact GitHub readback. This claim does not include TESTED, UI rendered, deployed, callable, executed, delivered, or accepted.
acceptance: Collapsed TalkBack cannot read every multi-kilobyte consequence from a broad constellation.
Collapsed output retains exact material-light total and exact active/blocked/fault/recovered counts.
A deterministic bounded prefix names light identity/state; verbose detail remains available per light.
Selection can be retained by stable semantic light id across scene reorder without breaking focus-index compatibility.
The new warm-wall constellation is DOM/vector source with native buttons, non-color state tokens, focus visibility, pressed selection, and no decorative blink loop.
No P0/phone mutation or duplicate controller is introduced.
Regression source exists, but TESTED is not promoted without executed checks.

codeFirstFindings.finding: The first collapsed-summary revision bounded the number of named lights but not each label, so twelve valid 160-character labels could still produce an unnecessarily long announcement.
codeFirstFindings.action: Corrected before review completion: collapsed labels are now limited to 64 Unicode code points with code-point-safe truncation; full labels remain available in per-light detail.
codeFirstFindings.regressionTarget: Broad 20-light source fixture with long labels/consequences remains under 2048 characters while preserving exact state counts; Unicode swan label truncation must not split a surrogate pair.

codeFirstFindings.finding: Focus-index-only detail lookup is not stable under auto-selected scene reorder and can make a persisted selection point at a different skill.
codeFirstFindings.action: Added stable node-id detail lookup plus focusIndexForId while preserving the existing focus-index API.
codeFirstFindings.regressionTarget: Reordered frame resolves the same semantic id to its new focus index and exact detail.

codeFirstFindings.finding: The new 16-light warm-wall specimen is useful only if its provenance/capability scar remains explicit.
codeFirstFindings.action: Specimen labels itself SOURCE / DOM/VECTOR PRIMITIVES / NOT OPERATOR-OVERLAY RUNTIME PROOF and carries repository_skill/doctrine/reviewer/runtime_boundary provenance.
